featured.why: In Egypt the C-section rate rose from 27.6% in 2008 to 51.8% in 2014 and 72.2% in 2021. Birth is a medical event and also a moment of autonomy and dignity: informed consent, power dynamics and respectful care. This matters to me because choice in childbirth should be informed, not fear-driven.

slides.d: Respect, communication and consent during childbirth.
